chooseResponse.q: What do you think about the new library hours?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Have you seen the new library hours?
Librarian: Yes, they've extended them until midnight!
Student: That's awesome! Now I can study late.
Librarian: Absolutely! It should really help students prepare for exams.

questions.q: What does the librarian think about the new hours?
questions.explain: 圖書館員認為新的開放時間對學生有幫助。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explain: 對話的主要主題是延長圖書館的開放時間。

announcement.transcript: Attention students! Starting next week, the campus gym will have extended hours. It will open at 6 AM and close at 11 PM. This change aims to accommodate all students' schedules better. Thank you for your continued support.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
options: To inform about extended gym hours
questions.explain: 公告的目的是告知學生健身房的開放時間延長。

questions.q: When will the new gym hours start?
questions.explain: 新的健身房開放時間將在下周開始。

talk.transcript: Today, I want to talk about the concept of sustainability. Sustainability refers to meeting our own needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. This idea encompasses environmental protection, economic viability, and social equity. By adopting sustainable practices, we can preserve our planet’s resources, reduce waste, and ensure a healthier ecosystem. For instance, using renewable energy sources is one way to promote sustainability. It helps decrease reliance on fossil fuels and reduces greenhouse gas emissions, contributing to a cleaner environment. Thus, sustainability is not just about conservation; it’s also about creating a balanced lifestyle for all.

questions.q: What does sustainability aim to achieve?
questions.explain: 可持續性旨在同時滿足當前和未來的需求。

questions.q: Which practice is suggested to promote sustainability?
questions.explain: 建議採取可再生能源以促進可持續性。

questions.q: What are the three aspects of sustainability mentioned?
questions.explain: 提到的可持續性的三個方面是環境、經濟和社會。

questions.q: How does renewable energy contribute to sustainability?
questions.explain: 可再生能源通過減少溫室氣體排放來促進可持續性。
